verdict_title: The modern challenger for esports and bet builder fans
verdict:
Midnite brings something genuinely different to Ireland: an esports-native bookmaker with a proper Irish licence, an interface that outclasses most legacy rivals and a welcome offer from just €5. With football props, GAA and racing covered, it works as an everyday bookmaker too.

The trade-offs are a smaller casino and a leaner promotions calendar than the 20-year veterans. But if your betting lives on your phone — especially if you love esports or same-game accas — Midnite is one of the most compelling sign-ups for Irish players right now.
